verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search and answer API, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only Perplexity-hosted services: the remote MCP endpoint, open-weight models "hosted by Perplexity", and Perplexity-run built-in tools. The open-source local MCP server is a stdio adapter that runs on your machine but still calls Perplexity's hosted API, so it is not a self-hostable core product. No deployable version of the Sonar or Search engine is documented.
